chapter: Learning drums and recording on the Coast
title: Staying at the Clark Hotel and the Capitol deal
summary: He stayed at the Clark Hotel, only recorded, got a good contract, and Dave Dexter was involved.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Do you remember where you stayed when you were in California making those records?
Yeah, I stayed at the Clark Hotel.
The Clark Hotel. Did Julia stay there too?
Yeah.
Was it a musician's hotel or --
No, just a regular hotel, everybody stopped there.
And you left Tilly back here in Kansas City.
Yeah.
Tilly is Mrs. Lovett who recently passed on, whom we all miss greatly. Well, how did you enjoy yourself in California on a record date? Did you play any gigs while you were there?
No.
No. You just went out there to record.
Record, that was all. No, I didn't play anywhere around there.
Did you get a good contract from Capitol?
Yeah, nice.
Everything was fine.
Yeah, oh, yeah. Dave Dexter.
Dave Dexter, did he produce it?
Oh,yeah.
Oh, you had a good man.
He was our announcer, you know.
Charles Crook Goodwin.
